freeze_rule: Immutable once frozen. Limits below are proposed campaign stimuli, not throughput promises. Do NOT adjust limits in response to an observed failure — ever. First collect the unobserved workload control; if it cannot meet its own deadline, mark the cell invalid and explain the environment before starting an observed comparison.

global.clock: monotonic with explicitly recorded cross-process/kernel anchors; wall-clock ordering alone is not identity

mode_decision.bounded_detail: Bounded detail capture may stop at 100,000 observations with explicit truncation (counted omissions, Partial completion).
mode_decision.continuous_summary: Continuous summaries must aggregate independently of retained per-request detail. This needs a P6 versioned output contract.
mode_decision.p6_gate: OPEN — P6 output-contract dependency recorded, streaming cells stay NOT_RUN until P6/P7 qualify them. Not designed here.
